scope: Only .cs code source files; no serialized Unity assets, packages, prefabs or config content.
design: Fresh isolated CodeGraph and conventional workers; same seven C# scenarios; independent tool-output logs, no context/result sharing.
measurement: stdout+stderr token counts from instrumented reading commands, including retries, failures, conventional CodeGraph fallbacks, plus CodeGraph skill text once; excludes agent reasoning, message tokens and model billing.

scenario_labels.S1: UserProfilePanel public and Unity lifecycle methods
scenario_labels.S2: BarcodeScannerWrapper camera permissions and scan lifecycle
scenario_labels.S3: WorldNavigationHelper overloads, routes and direct C# callsites
scenario_labels.S4: DisplayScriptResolver task caching, reference validation and errors
scenario_labels.S7: DisplayScriptResolver direct text in C# test files

codegraph_errors: S7 search_source under Tests: directory exists but contains no indexed source files; exit 1, not a verified absence
valid_no_matches: CodeGraph S7 verification rg on Tests *.cs
audit.quality: Equivalent core C# facts in S1-S7, including no direct C# GotoAreaLocation callsite beyond declaration. Tests scope was verified by conventional search after unindexed CodeGraph path.

limitations: One execution per arm; previous rerun showed materially different numbers with the same skill and code snapshot, demonstrating sensitivity to agent search strategy.
Only output tokens from instrumented reading operations and one skill document are included.
No claim of total prompt/reasoning token savings, billing savings, or universal benefit.
Unrelated pre-existing project/repository worktree modifications were preserved.
